emily: Heads-up — preparing an RC candidate for tomorrow's promo window. Artifact = candidate-2026-03-21-b42. Need canary in staging, then pin + promote during the 09:00-11:00 PT change window. @ops-oncall can you confirm quiet window and sheriff? :eyes:

maya: QA passed on staging smoke. small flake from earlier fixed in this build.

liam: DB migration is zero-downtime (mig_20260321_v1). I'll run preflight checks 30m before promote.

emily: @DeployBot create RC and pin artifact; queue a 5% canary in staging. Commands I'm going to run:
```
/deploy create --artifact candidate-2026-03-21-b42 --env staging --pin
/deploy canary --percent 5 --duration 15m
```

DeployBot: Queued: RC create job #6789. Pin applied to candidate-2026-03-21-b42. Canary scheduled in staging (starts in ~2m).

ops-oncall: Quiet window confirmed 09:00-11:00 PT tomorrow. I'm the sheriff for the promo, will be oncall and reachable.

sara: I'll run telemetry smoke (latency, p50/p95, error-rate, token cost) using eval set `rc-smoke-2026-03-21`. Posting initial baselines once canary completes first 10m.

DeployBot: Canary started: 5% traffic -> candidate-2026-03-21-b42. Observability links: https://dash/reports/rc-6789 and https://alerts/rc-6789.

sara: After 10m: latency +2ms p95, error-rate stable, token-cost unchanged. No regressions in core prompts. :thumbsup:

liam: Rollback plan is ready: `rollback --to pinned-stable-2026-03-14`. DB rollback safe; migration reversible step included.

maya: QA +1 for promo, no outstanding blockers.

emily: If metrics stay green we promote at 09:15 PT. Initiating promo window and handoff to ops.

DeployBot: Promotion scheduled for 09:15 PT. Plan = phased rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 5m observation at each step.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll watch traces, infra alerts, and token-cost dashboards. Ping me if any spike.

sara: I'm watching the eval harness and will post immediate signal if any regression appears.

DeployBot: Promotion started: 10% -> success. 50% -> success. 100% -> success. RC candidate promoted to prod. Artifact pinned as prod release `candidate-2026-03-21-b42`.

emily: Nice work. Release note stub: "Fixes tokenization edge-case that produced trailing spaces; includes safe DB migration; no perf regression observed." I'll update release notes and ship channel.

maya: Marking this thread resolved. :rocket:
